title: Coherent Heterogeneous SoC — first-pass projection study
alt: Front-facing planar SoC illustration with parallel CPU and NPU clusters, shared fabric, memory interface and host I/O. First-pass result with a reversed host path and appearance limitations.
strengths: The result is front-facing and planar, without the former isometric package base, physical materials or visible side faces.
CPU and NPU appear as aligned peers with their own cache resources; external DRAM and external host remain outside the system boundary.
Named resources are readable at the generated size, with a short mostly straight top-to-bottom visual path.
limitations: The path from Coherent Fabric to Host I/O is reversed relative to the source request, which requires PCIe Endpoint to Coherent Fabric. This prevents acceptance as an accurate engineering diagram.
The Shared Resources group title and its explicit ownership boundary are omitted, although Coherent Fabric and Shared LLC remain visible.

Several internal arrows are drawn even though the compiled annotated_context scope lists only two external links. The retained source description and selected-view scope still give the image model conflicting guidance.

Saturated blue, yellow, orange, green, red and purple fills exceed the restrained two-family palette request. Fills have tonal shading, outlines/arrows are heavy, and the large title competes with the structure.
This is one unedited first-pass observation, not a quality score or evidence of general success across models or topics.

provenance.workflow: Existing source input → current silicon_compile → exact compiled prompt → built-in Image Gen; no prompt augmentation, reference image or repair
provenance.actual_image_review: Visually inspected first pass. Projection correction is visible, but topology, ownership and color/typography limitations remain. Not accepted as an accurate final showcase figure.
